name: Jack Sour
description: Rye Whiskey, House Merlot, Fresh Lemon Juice, Sugar Cane Syrup. The first whiskey sour was made in 1872. We based our version off the classic using house-made ingriedents & rye whiskey

name: The Aviation Cocktail
description: London Dry Gin, Maraschino Liqueur, Fresh Lemon Juice, Violette Liqueur, Sugar Cane Syrup. This 1917 cocktail has become one of the more popular classics in bars where drinks are done right. Its tartness is clean and quenching while the sweetness is dry & refreshing

name: Hemingway Daiquiri
description: Aged Rum, Maraschino Liqueur, Fresh Grapefruit Juice, Fresh Lime Juice, Sugar Cane Syrup. Let's all thank Ernest for his love of alcohol! Without him we wouldn't have this delicious concoction

name: Flower Power
description: Vodka, House-Made Hibiscus Syrup, Fresh Lime Juice, Fresh Orange Juice, Orange and Lime Essential Oils. Vodka mixed with our sweet & aromatic, housemade hibiscus syrup, fresh lime and orange juices, & immune system boosting essential oils that add a rich, smooth texture to the cocktail

name: Stir 75
description: Broker's Dry Gin, La Marca Prosecco, Aperitivo Select, Fresh Lemon Juice, Sugar Cane Syrup. A refreshing spin on the classic "French 75" cocktail. We've paired London dry gin with fresh lemon juice, sugar, & a hint of Italian aperitif liqueur. Topped with Prosecco for a modern twist

name: Sbagliato Negroni
description: Campari, Carpano Antica Sweet Vermouth, La Marca Prosecco. Invented in 1919 & named for Count Camillo Negron. It took a secret handshake to order it and was a sign to bartenders that you knew what you liked

name: Whiskey Bramble
description: Bourbon, Cherry Amarascata, Fresh Lemon Juice, Orange Blossom Water, Sugar Cane Syrup. Tartness from cherry marries well with the sweetness of bourbon to create a delicious whiskey drink. We add some fresh squeezed lemon juice along with a few drops of orange blossom flower water for a sagacious libation

name: Viva La Astral
description: Tequila Reposado, Fresh Grapefruit and Fresh Lemon Juice, Jalapeño Pepper, Cucumber, Ginger Syrup, Sugar Cane Syrup. Tequila, grapefruit juice, lemon juice, and sugar mixed with jalapeño pepper, cucumber, & hous-made ginger syrup

name: Austin Mule
description: Tito's Vodka, House-Made Ginger Syrup, Fresh Lime Juice, Sugar Cane Syrup. We use our house-made ginger beer & Tito's to make a great classic cocktail

name: Elderflower Sour
description: Vodka, St. Germain Elderflower, Monin Lime, House-Made Ginger Syrup, Cucumber. The subtle sweetness of a flower coupled with vodka & the crisp dry sweetness of cucumber makes this drink a favorite. We add a bit of sour from preserved lime syrup & fresh ginger to give it a quenching result

name: 1948 Margarita
description: Tequila Reposado, Gran Gala, FreshLime Juice, Sugar Cane Syrup. A classic brought back from 1948 from the original Margarita Sames recipe. Served on rocks or shaved ice

name: Strawberry Moon Sangria
description: House Cabernet, Strawberry, Fresh Lemon Juice, Italian Cherry Syrup, Rose Petal Water, Vodka. Nicknamed by Native Americans, the full moon near the summer solstice was a signal to pick strawberries at the peak of their ripeness. We used their advice and made a cocktail with them
